shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- files ---'; rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'SKILL.md' -g '"'!node_modules'"' | sed -n '1,120p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- root ---'; ls -la; printf '%s\\n' '--- skill ---'; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- package.json ---'; cat package.json; printf '%s\\n' '--- src ---'; find src -maxdepth 2 -type f -print -exec sed -n '1,160p' {} \\;; printf '%s\\n' '--- routing top ---'; sed -n '1,90p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- traps ---'; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- skill steps 1-3 ---'; sed -n '45,150p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md"

/bin/bash -lc "npm install @gravity-ui/uikit && node -e \"console.log(require('@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').version)\" && printf '%s\\n' '--- setup ---' && sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md && printf '%s\\n' '--- docs index ---' && find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs -maxdepth 3 -type f | rg 'TextInput|Button|Checkbox|ThemeProvider|layout|theming' | sed -n '1,80p'"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"const p=require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json');console.log(p.version)\"; printf '%s\\n' '--- README setup ---'; rg -n -A 45 -i 'required setup|ThemeProvider|@gravity-ui/uikit/styles' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -n 100; printf '%s\\n' '--- docs ---'; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs -maxdepth 4 -type f | rg 'TextInput|Button|Checkbox|ThemeProvider|layout|theming' | sed -n '1,100p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- inspect script ---'; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit TextInput Button Checkbox ThemeProvider"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- README setup full ---'; sed -n '1,70p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- Button ---'; sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components/Button.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- Checkbox ---'; sed -n '1,190p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components/Checkbox.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- TextInput ---'; sed -n '1,230p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components/controls/TextInput.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- Provider/types ---'; rg -n 'declare function Provider|interface ProviderProps|type ProviderProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build -g '*.d.ts' | head -n 20"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- Button code/examples/props ---'; rg -n '"'^##|''^```|view=|size=|type=|width=|loading=|disabled='"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components/Button.md | head -n 80; printf '%s\\n' '--- Checkbox code/examples/props ---'; rg -n '"'^##|''^```|checked=|onChange=|content=|indeterminate=|disabled=|size='"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components/Checkbox.md | head -n 80; printf '%s\\n' '--- TextInput code/examples/props ---'; rg -n '"'^##|''^```|label=|value=|onUpdate=|type=|size=|placeholder=|error=|validationState=|note='"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components/controls/TextInput.md | head -n 100; printf '%s\\n' '--- Layout ---'; rg -n '"'^##|''^```|Flex|Box|direction=|gap=|alignItems=|justifyContent=|className=|style='"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides/layout.md | head -n 130"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '150,205p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components/Button.md; sed -n '53,78p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components/Checkbox.md; sed -n '100,137p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components/controls/TextInput.md; sed -n '1,45p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components/Button.md; sed -n '1,40p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components/Checkbox.md; rg -n 'export .*Flex|export .*Box|declare function Flex|declare function Box' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout -g '*.d.ts' | head -n 30; rg -n 'direction\\?:|justifyContent\\?:|alignItems\\?:|gap\\?:|width\\?:|height\\?:|padding\\?:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/*.d.ts | head -n 40"
/bin/bash -lc 'command -v apply_patch || true; ls /usr/local/bin | rg patch || true; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/.agent 2>/dev/null || true'
/bin/bash -lc 'cat src/main.tsx; cat src/App.tsx; cat src/index.css; which bash; echo $SHELL; alias | head'

/bin/bash -lc "npm run build && rg -o -- '--g-(color-base-generic|color-base-background|color-line-generic|color-text-primary|spacing-4|spacing-6|border-radius-l|text-body-font-family|text-header-1-[a-z-]+): ["'^;]+'"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | sort -u | head -n 30; git status --short"

rg -o -- '"'--g-(color-base-generic|color-base-background|color-line-generic|color-text-primary|spacing-4|spacing-6|border-radius-l|text-body-font-family|text-header-1-[a-z-]+): ["'^;]+'"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | sort -u | head -n 30"

/bin/bash -lc "npm run build; printf '%s\\n' '--- token definitions ---'; rg -n -- '--g-color-base-generic:|--g-color-base-background:|--g-color-line-generic:|--g-color-text-primary:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -n 20; printf '%s\\n' '--- changes ---'; git diff -- src package.json | sed -n '1,260p'"
